title: When the road feels heavy, remember this — God’s way may not be the easiest, but it will always lead you to the right place.
paragraphs:
When the road feels heavy, remember this — God’s way may not be the easiest, but it will always lead you to the right place.
Hold the faith. Walk the path. Trust the wisdom behind every step. ✨

Proverbs 3:5–6 (NIV)
“Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to Him, and He will make your paths straight.”
